context.id: Kota-kota padat seperti Firenze dan Venesia kehilangan hingga 65% populasi dalam waktu kurang dari 18 bulan.
context.en: Dense hubs like Florence and Venice lost up to 65% of their inhabitants within less than 18 months.

context.id: Penyebaran melompat lebih cepat melalui rute galai maritim (hingga 40 km/hari) dibanding rute darat pejalan kaki.
context.en: Spread accelerated along maritime galley routes (up to 40 km/day) compared to pedestrian carriage roads.

context.id: Populasi manusia di Eropa baru kembali ke level sebelum tahun 1347 pada awal abad ke-16.
context.en: European human population only returned to pre-1347 levels by the early 16th century.
